products.name: Lokalise AI
products.note: Localization AI; continuous translation; developer workflow; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Lokalise is a continuous localization and translation management platform that integrates into software development workflows to help teams ship localized products. The company describes itself as bringing localization into a single system that connects workflows, standardizes execution, and delivers consistent, on-brand experiences across markets. Its platform applies role-based access control across its interface and API, using the same RBAC model throughout.

Lokalise's AI product, Lokalise AI, sits at the center of its offering and covers a range of localization tasks including automated translation, quality evaluation, and terminology management. The platform uses Custom AI Profiles to supply surrounding context and metadata to AI models, and it scores translation quality automatically so that only low-confidence results are sent for human review. Lokalise also dynamically selects and routes translation requests to what it describes as the best-fit large language model based on language, content, and context, without requiring repeated manual configuration. The product is noted as UK-hosted.

The site's held facts confirm Lokalise maintains a tracked presence on theworldofai.org, with Lokalise AI categorized under Search, Research, Translation and Other. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the current held facts.
